settings.label: How many films
settings.description: The canvas asks for this many at a time and loads more as you scroll.

settings.label: Letterboxd username
settings.description: The public profile whose watchlist this plugin reads. The helper keeps it on this computer, and the profile has to be public.

auth.note: Sign in with the public Letterboxd username to read. No password, session or token is involved: the helper checks the name against letterboxd.com here and keeps it on this computer; nothing about it reaches your account.
